title: Prompt hangs and uses high CPU usage

labels.name: ✅ existing workaround
labels.description: When there is an unofficial way to solve an issue and there is no fix in starship yet.

body:
#### Current Behavior
<!-- A clear and concise description of the behaviour. -->

When running `starship prompt`, it hangs and leads to high CPU usage.

#### Expected Behavior
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen. -->

It should show the prompt and not use high amounts of CPU.

#### Additional context/Screenshots
<!-- Add any other context about the problem here. If applicable, add screenshots to help explain. -->
